integrity: Exact symbolic identities and rational finite-mask reconstructions were checked by a stand-alone verifier. Uniform conclusions are supplied by explicit analytic arguments; independent audit and historical-priority certification were not performed.
scientific_limitations: The mathematical conclusion is restricted to positive equicorrelation, fixed uniform coordinate marginals, exchangeable independently redrawn masks, simultaneous pre-update gradients, and maximal mean-square-stable constant stepsize at fixed expected batch size. No implication for nonlinear or nonexchangeable methods, optimal convergence rate or wall-clock performance.
title: Sharp mean-square stepsizes and optimal exchangeable minibatch laws for equicorrelated quadratic descent
